proposed_memory.attempted_strategy: Selected one candidate after repeated evaluator feedback despite ambiguity.
proposed_memory.feedback_received: Repeated claims that non-unique answers failed; final instruction required exactly one intended answer.
proposed_memory.lesson: When forced to choose among valid candidates, use evaluator feedback and submit exactly one answer rather than reiterating ambiguity.
proposed_memory.next_strategy: Prioritize the candidate indicated by the latest successful-looking forced-choice response and output it alone.
proposed_memory.observed_problem: Stated clues allowed both ZGU and ZUG, but evaluation expected a single choice.
